ownership.quote: Volcano Engine, founded in 2021, is ByteDance's cloud computing unit.

stage.quote: Volcano Engine, founded in 2021, is ByteDance's cloud computing unit.
stage.note: AgentKit is a product on Volcano Engine, itself a cloud business unit of ByteDance (a private company); no independent funding round for Volcano Engine or AgentKit was found, so the stage reflects it being a corporate cloud product line rather than a separately financed startup.

last_round.quote: ByteDance is backed financially by Jeff Yass's Susquehanna International Group, Primavera Capital Group, Kohlberg Kravis Roberts, SoftBank Group, Sequoia Capital, General Atlantic, and Hillhouse Capital Group.
last_round.note: No specific dated 'last round' with an amount was found for ByteDance or Volcano Engine; recent public information concerns secondary share-tender valuations, not a new primary funding round.

revenue.basis: Figure is for the whole of ByteDance Ltd. (parent company); Volcano Engine/AgentKit-specific revenue is not broken out and is unknown.

note: Volcano Engine (火山引擎) is ByteDance's public cloud brand, founded in 2021; AgentKit is one of its agent/sandbox products (also resold via BytePlus for international/Asia-Pacific customers). As a subsidiary product line, it has no independent funding history, investors, or revenue disclosure distinct from ByteDance as a whole. ByteDance itself is a private company (Cayman Islands VIE structure) valued at roughly $300 billion as of November 2024, backed by major institutional investors, with founder Zhang Yiming retaining majority voting control; it is not publicly traded.
